div.head: Wl art 3.1
div.ab: Et si quis de illis occisus fuerit, dominus eius habeat infra quinque dies homicidam eius, si potuerit; sin autem, incipiat persoluere mihi quadraginta sex marcas argenti, quamdiu substantia illius domini perdurauerit.

Et si quis de illis occisus fuerit, dominus eius habeat infra quinque dies homicidam eius, si potuerit; sin autem, incipiat persolvere mihi quadraginta sex marcas argenti, quamdiu substantia illius domini perduraverit.

And if any of them is slain, his lord shall arrest the slayer within five days, if he can. If not, however, he shall begin to pay me 46 marks of silver from the property of that lord as long as it lasts out.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 238–239 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text added from Gesetze I p. 487, October 2026 (two independent readings of the page images)

Im Ggs. zu den vor 1066 in England naturalisierten Franzosen u. 4.—Murdrum (s. d. Gl 8. 10b. 11. 14) fällt nicht schon dann fort, wenn Mörder bekannt war, sondern erst wenn er dem Gericht gestellt ward. Die Nationalität des Täters war im Authenticum nicht erwähnt

In contrast to the Frenchmen naturalized in England before 1066 below 4.—Murdrum (see that word in Gl 8. 10b. 11. 14) does not lapse as soon as the murderer was known, but only once he had been brought before the court. The nationality of the offender was not mentioned in the Authenticum
Auch Maitland Domesday 148 hält diese Haftung des Herrn für das frühere
Maitland Domesday 148 also takes this liability of the lord to be the earlier one
Dass hiervon 6 Mark der Sippe zufliessen, lässt Kompilator fort, wie so viele Einzelheiten u. 6. Der Ausdruck des Straffixums in Mark (s. d. Gl 1. 3) spricht für Entstehung des Instituts nách Cnut

The compiler omits that 6 marks of this go to the kindred, as he does so many details below 6. The expression of the fixed penalty in marks (see that word in Gl 1. 3) points to the institution having arisen after Cnut
